workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point layer into the census tract layer CRS so the spatial join can be performed with compatible coordinate reference systems.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject input_1 from its known CRS EPSG:4326 to EPSG:26918. Preserve all hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Join each hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it and return the tract identifier with the hospital attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a point-in-polygon spatial join using hospitals_epsg26918 as the hospital point layer and input_2 as the census tract polygon layer. Preserve the hospital attributes and attach the containing tract GEOID as the tract identifier.
